title: Tasbih Fatimah
arabic: سُبحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالحَمدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ)
transliteration: Subḥāna allāhi thalāthan wa thalāthīna wal-ḥamdu lillāhi thalāthan wa thalāthīna wallāhu akbaru arba'an wa thalāthīna
english: How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times)
